title: Total fall time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total time to fall using the free-fall equation from the given height.

title: First-second displacement
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the displacement during the first second of motion.

title: Last-second displacement
description: Important: Correctly calculates the displacement during the final second, using the difference in positions.

title: Half-time displacement
description: Important: Correctly calculates the displacement after half the total fall time.

title: Free-fall equation application
description: Important: Applies the correct kinematic equation for displacement under constant acceleration from rest.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Includes correct units (s, m) with all numerical answers.

title: Sign or conceptual error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect equation (e.g., v=gt for displacement) or misinterprets 'last second' or 'half the time'.
